article.title: Clinch把Higgsfield及字節模型接入廣告製作流程
article.summary: Clinch宣布在Flight Control加入Higgsfield、Seedream及Seedance，把圖像與影片生成接入廣告製作和投放流程。
highlights: 團隊可比較不同模型，並按組織設定模型存取及素材審批。
生成素材可進入可重用的動態廣告框架，再延伸至投放和衡量。
article.why: 這次整合把選模型和組裝廣告放進同一流程，創意營運團隊可評估哪些規格變體適合在平台內完成。
article.next_step: 選一組多尺寸商品廣告，分別用新增模型製作變體，核對素材框架能否保留必要文字及商品細節。
article.detail: Clinch表示，Seedream支援圖像生成，Seedance提供影片生成，Higgsfield則加入圖像與影片製作能力。Flight Control會把品牌指引、受眾、活動目標和素材規格用於內容製作。團隊可用同一組廣告規格比較模型，再追查從生成檔案到廣告框架的修改記錄，以決定哪些步驟仍需人工處理。
article.title_en: Clinch brings Higgsfield and ByteDance models into ad production
article.summary_en: Clinch added Higgsfield, Seedream and Seedance integrations to Flight Control, connecting image and video generation with ad production and activation.
highlights_en: Teams can compare models and configure model access and creative approvals.
Generated assets can flow into reusable dynamic creative frameworks and on to activation and measurement.
article.why_en: With model choice and ad assembly in one workflow, creative operations teams can assess which format variants to produce there.
article.next_step_en: Test one multi-size product ad set with the new models and check whether its framework preserves required text and product details.
article.detail_en: Clinch says Seedream supplies image generation, Seedance adds video, and Higgsfield supports both. Flight Control uses brand guidance, audience definitions, campaign goals and creative specifications. Compare models against one specification set and trace revisions into the ad framework to decide which steps still need manual work.
